priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The vendor-neutral telemetry boundary, structured correlation, redaction, and outage-tolerant foundation remain reachable; complete production observability is assessed separately under issue 68.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M1.7: Configure GitHub Actions CI and repository quality gates
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Repository tests verify the current Code Foundry workflow callers, required contexts, parallel validation groups, coverage publication, and direct-to-main release policy.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M1.8: Define deployment and infrastructure baseline
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The original AWS, ECS, and Terraform-oriented deployment baseline is no longer accepted; M9 replaced it with Railway, Neon, R2, and Restate, while M10 added Local and Hosted profiles.

gap.disposition: Retain only necessary migration provenance and remove any remaining code or active claims that imply the M1 deployment baseline is supported.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M1.9: Add platform-foundation acceptance test and architecture baseline
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The foundation acceptance suite still verifies service bootstrap, architecture ownership, adapter decisions, and the clean-checkout acceptance command.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M2.1: Define versioned Agent HQ service contracts and canonical identifiers
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current versioned request, response, envelope, identifier, authentication, and runtime-discovery schemas provide reachable contract evidence.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M2.2: Implement service authentication and caller-scope validation
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current tests reject malformed, expired, revoked, wrong-audience, wrong-class, and scope-conflicting credentials; Cloud now uses signed Ed25519 credentials rather than the early opaque-token shape.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M2.3: Implement immutable AgentProfile and Skill versioning
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Reachable catalog tests cover immutable publication, exact pins, lifecycle states, version conflicts, digests, and defensive retrieval.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M2.4: Define runtime capability and compatibility model
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The provider-neutral runtime capability and compatibility model remains reachable and is strengthened by later runtime eligibility and certification tests.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M2.5: Define tool, model, policy, and execution-limit domain contracts
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current domain tests preserve provider-neutral tool, model, runtime, policy, budget, interaction, and execution-limit constraints with fail-closed composition.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M2.6: Implement revisioned ProjectState and promotion proposals
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: ProjectState revision history, compare-and-set mutation, replay, and promotion-proposal transitions have current PostgreSQL-backed integration evidence.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M2.7: Implement reproducible ContextPackage compilation
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The core-domain suite exercises deterministic ContextPackage construction, bounded inputs, immutable identity, stale evidence, and digest validation.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M2.8: Implement immutable ExecutionPlan compiler
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current compiler tests cover immutable exact inputs, policy and budget constraints, deterministic plans, integrity checks, and classified compilation failures.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M2.9: Publish typed Control Plane SDK and contract-test harness
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The independently buildable SDK, deterministic OpenAPI compatibility checks, additive-change policy, and contract-test utilities remain reachable; M11 separately audits every claimed operation's production wiring.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M2.10: Add contracts and core-domain acceptance test
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The historical acceptance suite remains executable and useful for feature semantics, but it is not production-shaped release evidence after the M9 and M10 composition changes.

gap.disposition: Reclassify and rerun the relevant contract and domain cases in deterministic current-profile release lanes.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M3.1: Implement Execution and ExecutionAttempt lifecycle
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current lifecycle tests cover accepted, running, waiting, cancelling, completed, failed, and retry-related execution and attempt transitions.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M3.2: Implement CommandInbox idempotency and execution acceptance
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: CommandInbox remains the current durable idempotency boundary, with PostgreSQL and SQLite replay, conflict, and restart evidence.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M3.3: Implement durable ExecutionEvent log and transactional outbox
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Reachable event and database tests cover ordered durable events, normalized delivery, replay, redaction, and transactional effect boundaries.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M3.4: Implement Temporal execution lifecycle workflows
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Temporal is no longer an accepted runtime or release-evidence source; M9 replaced the Cloud workflow path with Restate and M10 carried Restate into Local and Hosted.

gap.disposition: Remove stale Temporal implementation and active claims while retaining only migration provenance needed to explain the Restate replacement.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M3.5: Implement cancellation, approval, and awaiting-input interactions
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current domain and workflow tests cover approval, denial, input waits, expiry, cancellation races, and deterministic terminal behavior.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M3.6: Deliver normalized execution events to Agent HQ
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Normalized delivery, outage retention, and replay are exercised locally, but no current live Agent HQ cross-product delivery certification exists.

gap.disposition: Exercise the current event-delivery implementation end to end through a supported standalone composition and preserve deterministic outage and replay evidence.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M3.7: Implement execution reconciliation and unknown-outcome recovery
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current tests preserve explicit reconciliation-required states, idempotent recovery, stable effects, and fail-closed handling of ambiguous outcomes.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M3.8: Add durable execution end-to-end acceptance suite
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The acceptance suite remains executable historical feature evidence, but current release interpretation requires Restate and exact Cloud, Local, or Hosted composition identity.

gap.disposition: Move durable lifecycle, restart, cancellation, interaction, and reconciliation coverage into deterministic Restate-backed current-profile lanes.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M4.1: Define RuntimeAdapter contract and conformance harness
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The current adapter-neutral runtime contract and reusable conformance behavior remain reachable.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M4.2: Implement RuntimeConnection registry and inventory persistence
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current tests cover scoped RuntimeConnection registration, inventory snapshots, stable identity, and persistence-port behavior.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M4.3: Implement runtime capability, health, and freshness ingestion
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Runtime capability, node/runtime health separation, freshness, degradation, and stale inventory handling remain directly tested.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M4.4: Implement deterministic runtime eligibility evaluation
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current tests cover deterministic eligibility decisions and explicit policy, capability, location, health, and freshness rejection reasons.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M4.5: Implement runtime routing and selection policy
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current routing tests cover policy precedence, explicit preferences, deterministic tie-breaking, degradation, and explainable selection.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M4.6: Implement external session reference and capability model
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The normalized external-session model, capability projection, opaque references, and stale capability behavior remain reachable.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M4.7: Expose normalized runtime discovery read models to Agent HQ
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The current Control API exposes scoped normalized runtime and external-session views without leaking native runtime handles or credentials.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M4.8: Add runtime fabric routing and discovery acceptance suite
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The historical suite remains useful executable feature evidence, but current certification must name the exact adapter, driver, transport, harness, profile, and location.

gap.disposition: Split routing and discovery acceptance into deterministic lanes keyed to exact current runtime topology and deployment profile.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M5.1: Define Runtime Gateway protocol and command envelopes
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The versioned Runtime Gateway protocol remains verified for non-co-located RuntimeNodes; it is not the Local co-located critical path.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M5.2: Implement RuntimeNode channel authentication and revocation
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Wrong audience, node, workspace, expiry, replay, and revocation controls remain verified for remote Runtime Gateway channels only.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M5.3: Implement scalable Runtime Gateway WebSocket lifecycle
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Heartbeat, reconnect, malformed frame, payload bound, backpressure, and multi-instance lifecycle behavior remain verified for remote gateway topology.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M5.4: Implement durable Runtime Gateway command ledger and ACK semantics
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Lost ACK, loss before ACK, duplicate result, expiry, and stable command identity remain verified for non-co-located runtime delivery.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M5.5: Ingest runtime progress, results, cancellation, and interaction events
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Duplicate delivery, normalized progress and result effects, interaction events, and cancellation races remain verified for gateway-connected runtimes.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M5.6: Synchronize RuntimeNode inventory and health through the gateway
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Inventory snapshots, omission, explicit removal, health, and reconnect continuity remain verified for remote RuntimeNodes.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M5.7: Implement gateway reconnect reconciliation and stale-command recovery
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Restart reconciliation, retained terminal outcomes, stale commands, expiry, revocation, and capability incompatibility remain verified for gateway-connected runtimes.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M5.8: Add Runtime Gateway security and recovery acceptance suite
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The aggregate gateway suite currently imports and checks the complete security and recovery matrix, scoped to non-co-located RuntimeNodes rather than Local direct transport.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M6.1: Implement ManagedPiAdapter configuration and event normalization
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Managed Pi configuration, capability projection, normalized events, interaction handling, cancellation, and failure classification remain reachable.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M6.2: Integrate local managed Pi execution through Runtime Gateway
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: M10 removed Runtime Gateway from the Local critical path and replaced this topology with DirectLocalRuntimeTransport; gateway delivery remains valid only for non-co-located nodes.

gap.disposition: Remove stale Local-through-Gateway code and claims while preserving the remote-gateway implementation for non-co-located RuntimeNodes.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M6.3: Implement hosted managed Pi runtime worker
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Hosted managed Pi worker selection, explicit and automatic routing, event normalization, and failure behavior remain verified; the worker is not part of the accepted Railway Cloud service topology.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M6.4: Implement ACP RuntimeAdapter and protocol normalization
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The ACP adapter's provider-neutral execution, capability, interaction, cancellation, crash, disconnect, and protocol normalization behavior remains reachable.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M6.5: Implement ACP external session listing, reference, and resume operations
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current tests cover normalized listing, opaque references, scoped resume, and behavior with and without history support.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M6.6: Integrate local ACP runtimes through Runtime Gateway
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: M10 replaced Local ACP gateway transport with direct co-located transport; Runtime Gateway remains supported only when the ACP RuntimeNode is non-co-located.

gap.disposition: Remove stale Local ACP-through-Gateway paths and claims while retaining explicitly remote Runtime Gateway support.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M6.7: Establish runtime compatibility matrix and adapter certification
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Machine-readable compatibility and adapter certification remain verified, with certification scoped to exact adapter, driver, transport, harness, protocol, profile, and location.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M6.8: Add managed Pi and ACP cross-runtime acceptance suite
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The historical cross-adapter suite remains executable, but its release meaning changed when Local adopted direct transport and Cloud removed the former runtime-worker topology.

gap.disposition: Rebuild cross-runtime acceptance around exact supported profile, adapter, driver, and transport combinations.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M7.1: Implement Tool Gateway registry and provider-neutral tool contracts
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current acceptance evidence covers provider-neutral tool definitions, registration, schema validation, and stable invocation identity.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M7.2: Implement policy-controlled tool execution, approvals, and audit
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Policy authorization, approval requirements, scoped credentials, audit effects, duplicate protection, and fail-closed tool faults remain exercised.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M7.3: Implement MCP tool interoperability adapter
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: MCP discovery, invocation normalization, schema checking, provider failures, and bounded outputs have reachable adapter-level evidence.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M7.4: Implement PolicyDecisionPoint and Cedar authorization adapter
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The provider-neutral policy decision boundary and Cedar-compatible authorization behavior remain reachable with deny-by-default and explicit approval outcomes.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M7.5: Implement connector credential vault and scoped credential leases
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current vault tests cover encrypted references, scoped bounded leases, revocation, rotation, zeroization, and prevention of reusable-secret leakage.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M7.6: Implement managed model gateway behind provider-neutral contracts
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The managed model boundary remains provider-neutral and has reachable tests for normalized requests, responses, accounting, health, and provider failure behavior.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M7.7: Implement deterministic model routing, health, and fallback policy
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Reachable tests cover deterministic model selection, health and compatibility filtering, bounded fallback, and explicit failure when no eligible route remains.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M7.8: Implement SandboxProvider and E2B isolated execution adapter
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The replaceable SandboxProvider and E2B-compatible adapter behavior are verified at the contract and fake-provider level, including isolation, bounds, and authorized artifact promotion; this does not claim live E2B certification.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M7.9: Implement authoritative usage ledger, reservations, and budget enforcement
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Usage reservations, settlement, idempotency, budget rejection, and authoritative durable ledger behavior have reachable implementation and repository tests.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M7.10: Add tools, models, policy, sandbox, and budget acceptance suite
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The historical aggregate suite remains executable and exercises important feature seams, but it is not current profile-specific production wiring or live-provider evidence.

gap.disposition: Place tool, model, policy, sandbox, credential, and usage cases into deterministic current-profile lanes with explicit provider classifications.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M8.1: Implement LangGraph orchestration adapter
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The bounded LangGraph adapter remains reachable with graph execution, interrupts, normalized state, and durable orchestration integration.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M8.2: Implement versioned graph definitions and checkpoint persistence
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Versioned graph definitions and PostgreSQL checkpoint persistence have current integration evidence, with graph state kept distinct from ProjectState.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M8.3: Implement Temporal-to-LangGraph segment and interrupt boundary
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The graph-segment and interrupt behavior remains, but the Temporal boundary named by the issue was replaced by the current Restate workflow worker.

gap.disposition: Remove stale Temporal-specific boundary code and terminology while retaining and simplifying the Restate-to-LangGraph segment behavior.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M8.4: Implement delegated parent and child executions
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Parent-child identity, durable delegation state, constrained child plans, completion propagation, and replay behavior remain directly tested.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M8.5: Implement parallel delegation, context/budget inheritance, and state promotion
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current tests cover parallel children, restrictive context and privilege inheritance, budget reservation, fan-in, conflicts, cancellation, duplicate effects, and explicit state promotion.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M8.6: Add multi-agent delegation and orchestration acceptance suite
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The historical aggregate suite remains executable and covers rich success and failure behavior, but it is not independently rerun through exact current Restate and deployment-profile compositions.

gap.disposition: Promote delegation, graph interruption, fan-in, budget, and recovery scenarios into deterministic current-profile release lanes.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9.1: Complete GenAI observability, tracing, and operational diagnostics
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Correlation, redaction, secret-canary protection, telemetry outage tolerance, and synthetic overhead evidence are reachable, but there is no complete live end-to-end trace and alert artifact across the accepted Railway and Restate topology; original scope also names superseded Temporal and removed Cloud gateway services.

gap.disposition: Audit and exercise the complete accepted topology's traces, metrics, alerts, outage behavior, and diagnostic runbooks without relying on superseded components.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9.2: Implement eval framework and profile, skill, runtime, and model release gates
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Deterministic immutable eval records, baseline comparisons, blocking gates, explicit promotion, rollback, and audit-failure behavior are tested, but controlled live-provider suites, broader evaluation dimensions, and scheduled production-shaped evidence are not recorded.

gap.disposition: Complete version-pinned adversarial and live-provider eval coverage, broader quality dimensions, reproducible baseline comparisons, and release-gate evidence.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9.3: Harden tenant isolation, policy boundaries, and secret leakage defenses
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Reachable evidence includes live authentication failures and log-secret checks plus the synthetic isolation matrix, secret-canary matrix, prompt-injection, credential-class, and release-blocking controls; M11 still re-audits boundaries changed by M10.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9.4: Add failure injection, chaos, and disaster-recovery validation
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Durable acceptance failure injection, service and Restate restart, replay, and bounded no-loss evidence exist, but timed RTO, complete restore, sustained disaster recovery, and several original superseded Temporal or Cloud gateway scenarios are not certified.

gap.disposition: Run the complete current-profile failure, restore, restart, reconciliation, RPO, and RTO matrix against accepted implementations and preserve conclusive evidence.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9.5: Establish load, performance, capacity, and cost baselines
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Synthetic 2,000-operation profiles, telemetry overhead, a five-request live staging sample, resource snapshots, and a short cost projection exist, but they do not establish sustained production scale, saturation, autoscaling, or reliable monthly cost baselines.

gap.disposition: Execute representative sustained, saturation, backpressure, capacity, and cost tests across exact release profiles with reproducible budgets and attribution.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9.6: Activate Railway staging and certify the managed-cloud deployment
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The recorded staging candidate completed authenticated acceptance, Neon persistence, Restate workflow execution and restart, R2 integrity, replay, health, bounded concurrency, and security checks; this verification is staging-only and does not certify production, Agent HQ, Local, or Hosted.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M7.11: Implement optional context and memory provider framework
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current tests cover optional and absent providers, deterministic eligibility, scope, policy, health, budgets, bounds, failure behavior, degradation, and cache isolation.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M7.12: Implement Cortana context provider adapter and ContextBundle pinning
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The adapter contract, MCP and HTTP normalization, ContextBundle snapshot, scope and digest pins, retry, timeout, circuit, and no-provider fallback are verified; live Cortana cross-product certification is outside this issue and remains M12 work.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M7.13: Implement memory write proposals and provider write policy
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current tests cover non-canonical proposals, approval, denial, expiry, revocation, idempotent effects, timeout reconciliation, scope rejection, and bounded content.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M10.1: Port Restate durable execution to Local and Hosted profiles
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Local embedded and Hosted remote Restate startup, version pinning, persistence, readiness, endpoint registration, failure cleanup, dependency loss, and restart recovery have reachable evidence.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M10.2: Extract shared core and deployment-profile infrastructure ports
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The current deployment package publishes the accepted Cloud, Local, and Hosted profile boundaries while shared domain code remains separated from provider implementations.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M10.3: Implement embedded SQLite persistence for the Local profile
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Real node:sqlite repositories, migrations, concurrent acceptance serialization, reopen replay, checkpoint, integrity verification, restore, and composition boot evidence are reachable.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M10.4: Implement the Local all-in-one Control Plane composition
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The production Local entry point composes SQLite, filesystem artifacts, local secrets, bundled Restate, direct runtime transport, loopback API, health, authentication, and optional outbound relay with zero mandatory external services; packaged macOS remeasurement is an M11 gate.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M10.7: Ship the Hosted/VPS Docker Compose reference deployment
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Hosted Simple and Hosted Server images and Compose topologies launch with private dependencies, persistent user-owned storage, migrations, health, readiness, and forced recreation evidence; this does not claim generic VPS capacity certification.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M10.5: Add direct-local RuntimeTransport and remove Runtime Gateway from the Local critical path
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Direct-local transport delegates runtime semantics without serialization, remains normalized against remote transport, and is exercised by the Local composition without starting Runtime Gateway.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M10.8: Implement host-side durable remote-control relay and E2E payload contract
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Reachable tests cover RFC 9180 HPKE, browser-compatible fixtures, associated-data binding, wrong keys, bounds, rotation, revocation, outbound-only polling, ciphertext opacity, reconnect, redelivery, and exactly-once acceptance through the real CommandInbox boundary; no live Agent HQ deployment is claimed.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M10.9: Prove Local and Hosted conformance against the M9 cloud baseline
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The versioned report compares four named profiles and exercises concrete SQLite plus Hosted PostgreSQL paths, but its Cloud adapter labels in-memory repositories and logical case functions as PostgreSQL-Neon and R2 rather than running against the accepted Railway, Neon, R2, and Restate candidate; several required runtime, tool, model, sandbox, delegation, and restart scenarios are not production-shaped.

gap.disposition: Replace the in-memory Cloud substitute with the accepted M9 managed-cloud composition and run the complete required semantic matrix against concrete Local, Hosted Simple, and Hosted Server profiles.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M10.10: Implement deployment-profile export, import, and migration tooling
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current tests cover deterministic manifests, digests, safe subsets, active-work blocking, secret canaries, dry-run planning, conflicts, capability and secret preflight, transactional apply, idempotent replay, artifact rollback, and concrete SQLite and PostgreSQL ports; live Neon execution is a separate release lane.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M10.6: Add Local and Hosted SecretsProvider adapters
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Environment references, owner-only private files, symlink and mode rejection, opaque host-secure handles, provider routing, bounded leases, closure, and zeroization remain directly tested.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9.10: Freeze v1 public schema, event, pagination, and error contracts
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Deterministic generated OpenAPI compatibility, additive-change rules, major-version protection, normalized envelopes, pagination, and error schemas provide current contract-freeze evidence; operation reachability is a separate M11 audit.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9.11: Finalize AgentProfile and Skill resolution, versioning, and trust rules
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current tests and catalog implementation cover deterministic dependency resolution, exact pins, version ranges, cycles, prereleases, lifecycle trust states, compatibility, and fail-closed authority composition.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9.12: Finalize deterministic ContextProvider selection, caching, and default policy
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Deterministic selection, no-provider operation, scope and policy checks, cache isolation, bounded output, timeout, degradation, substitution, and explicit failure behavior remain directly tested.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9.13: Centralize operational defaults, retention, retry, and transport limits
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The accepted heartbeat, freshness, retention, expiry, payload, request, drain, retry, and jitter defaults have a stable digest and bounded override tests.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M10.11: Harden Local and Hosted deployment, backup, and runbooks
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Developer-host and Linux evidence covers Local and Hosted startup, readiness, dependency disruption, checkpoint and restore, recreation, migrations, relay semantics, runbooks, resource snapshots, and bounded request samples, but the issue depends on incomplete issue 207, packaged-desktop certification remains open, an earlier Hosted saturation probe was inconclusive, and the record explicitly is not independent capacity certification.

gap.disposition: Complete packaged Local and production-shaped Hosted recovery, sleep-wake, host-loss, upgrade, rollback, and operational drills, then reconcile them with the corrected live-profile conformance evidence; performance saturation remains coordinated with M11.8.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9.7: Replace the AWS/ECS deployment baseline with Railway-native service builds
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Repository-owned dependency-aware Railway builds and the accepted Control API plus workflow-worker topology are statically verified and were exercised by fresh live staging builds.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9.8: Replace Temporal with Restate in the Railway managed-cloud profile
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The accepted Railway profile uses pinned private Restate with persistent state, native request identity, registered execution lifecycle, restart survival, and no active Temporal dependency.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9.9: Wire Railway, Neon, R2, secrets, networking, and health contracts
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Typed dependency ownership, private networking, signed service auth, Neon roles and migration, R2 integrity, Restate identity, health, readiness, and redaction were exercised in staging; production remains unactivated.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9 follow-up: correct Restate dependency ownership and request identity
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The active caller owns private Restate ingress, the worker validates native request identity, the obsolete fabricated bearer-token contract is absent, and the live worker key matched the Restate volume identity.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9: persist execution plans in Postgres for Cloud acceptance
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The PostgreSQL ExecutionPlan repository has current integration coverage for durable writes, restart-equivalent reads, exact ID and digest lookup, replay, conflict, and integrity behavior.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9: persist ProjectState history and promotion proposals in Postgres
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current PostgreSQL integration tests cover ProjectState current and historical revisions, mutation identity, compare-and-set concurrency, restart reads, and promotion-proposal transitions.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9: persist immutable ContextPackages in Postgres
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The PostgreSQL ContextPackage repository has reachable integration evidence for restart persistence, identical replay, conflicts, digest-scoped retrieval, and integrity checks.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9: add authenticated execution validation API
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: The versioned validation endpoint requires authentication and scope, resolves exact durable evidence, compiles and persists the immutable plan before success, and fails closed for malformed, unauthorized, missing, stale, or tampered inputs.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9: configure signed Cloud service credential verification
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current tests verify Ed25519 signatures, issuer, audience, key ID, algorithm, expiry, revocation, scope, credential class, and redacted failures; live staging rejected absent and malformed credentials.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9: compose Neon-backed Cloud control-api startup
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Cloud startup constructs durable PostgreSQL repositories and signed authentication, probes the database before readiness, closes resources on shutdown, and fails without in-memory fallback when dependencies are unavailable.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9: accept Cloud executions and submit Restate workflows
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Current tests and live staging evidence cover authenticated durable acceptance, stable execution identity, Restate submission, deterministic replay, payload conflict, and reconciliation-required handling after uncertain dispatch.

priorMilestoneAudits.title: M9.14: Finalize cost-minimized Railway staging and production standby
priorMilestoneAudits.assessment: Live closeout evidence records fresh builds, guarded source disconnection, zero running compute, retained staging Restate volume, preserved Neon and R2 state, cost controls, and explicit reactivation boundaries; production remains deliberately unavailable and uncertified.

contradictions.resolution: Restate is canonical; Temporal remains historical provenance only.

contradictions.topic: AWS and pnpm versus Railway and Bun
contradictions.resolution: Bun and Railway/Neon/R2 are current first-party choices; portable adapters preserve Hosted alternatives.
Cloud and Hosted Server use PostgreSQL; Local and Hosted Simple use SQLite behind shared persistence semantics.

contradictions.topic: Mandatory Local Runtime Gateway versus direct transport
contradictions.resolution: Co-located Local uses DirectLocalRuntimeTransport; Runtime Gateway remains for non-co-located nodes.

contradictions.topic: Prose contract v1 versus machine contract 2.0
contradictions.resolution: Machine-readable Control API 2.0 owns exact wire shape; prose retains semantic inventory pending reconciliation.
